title_en: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 1M Context, #1 on AA Coding Agent Index
title_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon：1M 上下文，AA 编码代理指数第一
summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, a reasoning model positioned between Gemini 4 Carbon and Hydrogen, targeting coding agents, knowledge work, and science workflows. It features a 1M-token unified context, 64K default output (up to 1M via background long decode), and multiple thinking levels. Neon scores 61 on the AA Intelligence Index, ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 (59) and GPT-6.2 Sol (57), and ranks #1 on the AA Coding Agent Index at 58.6. It achieves 95.2% on GraphWalks (256K to 1M context) but trails Opus 5.5 on Terminal-bench 4.1 (65.2% vs 65.8%) and FrontierCode 2.0 (46.2% vs 47.3%). Pricing is $3 per 1M input tokens and $15 per 1M output tokens, with closed weights and Google-hosted only.
summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemini 4 Neon，这是一款介于 Gemini 4 Carbon 和 Hydrogen 之间的推理模型，面向编码代理、知识工作和科学工作流。它具备 1M token 统一上下文，默认输出 64K（通过后台长解码可达 1M），并提供多个思考层级。Neon 在 AA 智能指数上得分为 61，领先于 Claude Opus 5.5（59）和 GPT-6.2 Sol（57），并在 AA 编码代理指数上以 58.6 分排名第一。它在 GraphWalks（256K 至 1M 上下文）上达到 95.2%，但在 Terminal-bench 4.1（65.2% vs 65.8%）和 FrontierCode 2.0（46.2% vs 47.3%）上落后于 Opus 5.5。定价为每 1M 输入 token 3 美元、每 1M 输出 token 15 美元，权重闭源且仅由 Google 托管。
content_en:
Google DeepMind just released Gemini 4 Neon. Gemini 4 Neon is a reasoning model that sits between Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Hydrogen. It targets coding agents, knowledge work and science workflows. The developer pitch is near-frontier scores at a lower cost per task. Pricing is $3 per 1M input tokens and $15 per 1M output tokens.

## **TL;DR**

- **Size:** 1M-token unified context, 64K default output, up to 1M via background long decode.
- **Runs on:** Google-hosted only. Closed weights, so no local GPU, quantized or edge builds.
- **Performance:** 61 on the AA Intelligence Index, ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 (59) and GPT-6.2 Sol (57).
- **Best:** 95.2% on GraphWalks (256K to 1M context), vs 80.1% for GPT-6.2 Sol.
- **Worst:** 46.2% on FrontierCode 2.0, behind Claude Opus 5.5 at 47.3%.
- **Bottom line:** Best: leads long-context and agentic coding at $3/$15. Worst: closed, self-reported, pricier per token than GPT-6.2 Sol.

## **What is Gemini 4 Neon?**

Neon is the middle model in the Gemini 4 family. Carbon handles the hardest long-horizon projects. Hydrogen handles fast everyday execution. Neon balances depth and efficiency between the two.

As per the model card, Neon is adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon. Google does not disclose parameter count or architecture. Inputs cover text, images, audio and video. The knowledge cutoff is March 2026.

## **How does Neon work inside agent workflows?**

Neon exposes multiple thinking levels. High is the default. xhigh is reserved for the hardest engineering, analytical and science workloads.

For long agent runs, Neon supports context compaction and makes fewer redundant file reads. In Google Antigravity, Neon can act as an orchestrator. It directs parallel Gemini 4 Hydrogen subagents on smaller subtasks.

## **How does Gemini 4 Neon perform on benchmarks?**

Google compares Neon against Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol. All scores below are reported by Google, not independently reproduced.

- **Coding:** #1 on the AA Coding Agent Index at 58.6. SWE-sweep with provider harness hits 39.0%, vs 10.1% for Opus 5.5.
- **Knowledge work:** 56.3% on Zapier AutomationBench, vs 42.5% for Opus 5.5. 75.8% on Agents’ Last Exam v1.1.
- **Science and reasoning:** 84.0% on RiemannBench, 70.5% on Terminal-Bench-Science and 71.3% on HLE-Diamond.
- **Long context:** 95.2% on GraphWalks, vs 66.8% for Opus 5.5.
- **Cyber:** 90.5% on SEC-bench Pro, 70.7% on CWE-Bench v2 and 51.3% on WebExploitBench v1.2.

Neon does not win every row. Opus 5.5 leads Terminal-bench 4.1 (65.8% vs 65.2%) and FrontierCode 2.0 (47.3% vs 46.2%). GPT-6.2 Sol leads Chartography (75.1% vs 73.5%).

On the Vals Index, Neon scores 70.9% and ranks #2. On the Agent Arena index it also ranks #2, with a score of 1336.

## **What does Gemini 4 Neon cost?**

Neon lists at $3 input, $0.15 cached input and $15 output per 1M tokens. Google says Neon at high thinking costs 32% less per task than Carbon. It also claims 50% to 80% lower cost per task vs rivals on Vals Index and Agent Arena. At xhigh, Google cites 36%+ lower cost than rivals at their highest settings.

Those are per-task claims, not per-token prices. GPT-6.2 Sol lists at $2/$10. Claude Opus 5.5 lists at $4/$20. Gemini 4 Carbon is $2/$10 until November 30, then $4/$20.

## **Where can developers use Gemini 4 Neon?**

- Gemini API paid tier, via Google AI Studio and Android Studio
- Gemini for business, via API and the model dropdown
- Google Antigravity, for paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers
- The Gemini app, for Pro and Ultra subscribers

## **What do the safety numbers show?**

Neon runs on the Gemini 4 safety and security stack. Google reports a 0.09% misaligned action rate on its agentic safety suite. It passes 99.2% of the agent honesty evaluation. It shows a 0.0% attack success rate on Gray Swan’s prompt injection benchmark at the highest thinking level. Its 2.45% shortcut rate on a coding cheating test is the lowest of any Gemini 4 model.

## **Gemini 4 Neon vs closest competitors**

| Feature | Gemini 4 Neon | Gemini 4 Carbon | Claude Opus 5.5 | GPT-6.2 Sol | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Developer | Google DeepMind | Google DeepMind | Anthropic | OpenAI | 
| Parameters | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | 
| Weights | Closed | Closed | Closed | Closed | 
| Context window | 1M | Not disclosed in launch post | 1M | 1M | 
| Max output | 64K default, 1M background | Not disclosed | 128K | Not disclosed | 
| Input / output per 1M | $3 / $15 | $2 / $10 to Nov 30, then $4 / $20 | $4 / $20 | $2 / $10 | 
| AA Intelligence Index | 61 | Not disclosed | 59 | 57 | 
| Vals Index v2.2\* | 70.9% | Not disclosed | 70.1% | 66.1% | 
| Terminal-bench 4.1\* | 65.2% | Not disclosed | 65.8% | 61.5% | 
| SWE-sweep (provider harness)\* | 39.0% | Not disclosed | 10.1% | 8.3% | 
| GraphWalks 256K to 1M\* | 95.2% | Not disclosed | 66.8% | 80.1% | 

*\*Scores from Google’s launch comparison table, self-reported. AA scores for Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol match Artificial Analysis.*

## **Key Takeaways**

- Neon sits between Carbon and Hydrogen, priced at $3/$15 per 1M tokens.
- Scores 61 on AA Intelligence Index, #1 on AA Coding Agent Index.
- Biggest lead: 95.2% on GraphWalks long-context recall.
- Trails Opus 5.5 on Terminal-bench 4.1 and FrontierCode 2.0.
- Closed and API-only, with Google-reported benchmarks.

content_zh:
Google DeepMind 刚刚发布了 Gemini 4 Neon。Gemini 4 Neon 是一款推理模型，定位介于 Gemini 4 Carbon 和 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 之间。它面向编程智能体、知识工作和科学工作流。开发者宣传的卖点是：以更低的单任务成本，达到接近前沿的分数。定价为每 100 万输入 token 3 美元，每 100 万输出 token 15 美元。

## **要点速览**

- **规模：** 100 万 token 统一上下文，默认输出 64K，通过后台长解码最高可达 100 万。
- **运行环境：** 仅限 Google 托管。权重闭源，因此没有本地 GPU、量化或边缘版本。
- **性能：** AA Intelligence Index 得分 61，领先 Claude Opus 5.5（59）和 GPT-6.2 Sol（57）。
- **最佳表现：** GraphWalks（256K 至 100 万上下文）得分 95.2%，而 GPT-6.2 Sol 为 80.1%。
- **最差表现：** FrontierCode 2.0 得分 46.2%，落后于 Claude Opus 5.5 的 47.3%。
- **总结：** 最佳：以每百万 token 3 美元/15 美元的价格在长上下文和智能体编程方面领先。最差：闭源、自报数据、每 token 价格高于 GPT-6.2 Sol。

## **什么是 Gemini 4 Neon？**

Neon 是 Gemini 4 家族中的中间型号。Carbon 负责最困难的长周期项目。Hydrogen 负责快速的日常执行。Neon 在两者之间平衡深度与效率。

根据模型卡，Neon 基于 Gemini 4 Carbon 适配而来。Google 未披露参数数量或架构。输入涵盖文本、图像、音频和视频。知识截止日期为 2026 年 3 月。

## **Neon 在智能体工作流中如何运作？**

Neon 提供多个思考级别。High 为默认级别。xhigh 保留给最困难的工程、分析和科学工作负载。

对于长时间智能体运行，Neon 支持上下文压缩，并减少冗余的文件读取。在 Google Antigravity 中，Neon 可以充当编排器。它指挥并行的 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 子智能体处理更小的子任务。

## **Gemini 4 Neon 在基准测试中表现如何？**

Google 将 Neon 与 Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 进行对比。以下所有分数均由 Google 报告，未经独立复现。

- **编程：** AA Coding Agent Index 以 58.6 排名第一。使用提供商测试框架的 SWE-sweep 达到 39.0%，而 Opus 5.5 为 10.1%。
- **知识工作：** Zapier AutomationBench 得分 56.3%，而 Opus 5.5 为 42.5%。Agents’ Last Exam v1.1 得分 75.8%。
- **科学与推理：** RiemannBench 得分 84.0%，Terminal-Bench-Science 得分 70.5%，HLE-Diamond 得分 71.3%。
- **长上下文：** GraphWalks 得分 95.2%，而 Opus 5.5 为 66.8%。
- **网络安全：** SEC-bench Pro 得分 90.5%，CWE-Bench v2 得分 70.7%，WebExploitBench v1.2 得分 51.3%。

Neon 并非每一行都获胜。Opus 5.5 在 Terminal-bench 4.1（65.8% 对 65.2%）和 FrontierCode 2.0（47.3% 对 46.2%）上领先。GPT-6.2 Sol 在 Chartography 上领先（75.1% 对 73.5%）。

在 Vals Index 上，Neon 得分 70.9%，排名第 2。在 Agent Arena 指数上同样排名第 2，得分为 1336。

## **Gemini 4 Neon 的成本是多少？**

Neon 的标价为每 100 万 token 输入 3 美元、缓存输入 0.15 美元、输出 15 美元。Google 表示，Neon 在 high 思考级别下，单任务成本比 Carbon 低 32%。它还声称，在 Vals Index 和 Agent Arena 上，单任务成本比竞争对手低 50% 至 80%。在 xhigh 级别下，Google 引用的是比竞争对手最高设置低 36% 以上的成本。

这些是按任务计费的价格，而非按 token 计费的价格。GPT-6.2 Sol 标价为 $2/$10。Claude Opus 5.5 标价为 $4/$20。Gemini 4 Carbon 在 11 月 30 日之前为 $2/$10，之后为 $4/$20。

## **开发者可以在哪里使用 Gemini 4 Neon？**

- Gemini API 付费层级，通过 Google AI Studio 和 Android Studio
- Gemini for business，通过 API 和模型下拉菜单
- Google Antigravity，面向付费的 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅用户
- Gemini 应用，面向 Pro 和 Ultra 订阅用户

## **安全数据说明了什么？**

Neon 运行在 Gemini 4 安全与保障技术栈之上。Google 报告其智能体安全套件上的错位行动率为 0.09%。它通过了 99.2% 的智能体诚实度评估。在最高思考层级下，它在 Gray Swan 的提示注入基准上显示出 0.0% 的攻击成功率。其在编码作弊测试中的 2.45% 捷径率为所有 Gemini 4 模型中最低。

## **Gemini 4 Neon 与最接近的竞品对比**

| 特性 | Gemini 4 Neon | Gemini 4 Carbon | Claude Opus 5.5 | GPT-6.2 Sol | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 开发者 | Google DeepMind | Google DeepMind | Anthropic | OpenAI | 
| 参数量 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 
| 权重 | 闭源 | 闭源 | 闭源 | 闭源 | 
| 上下文窗口 | 1M | 发布帖中未披露 | 1M | 1M | 
| 最大输出 | 默认 64K，后台 1M | 未披露 | 128K | 未披露 | 
| 每 1M 输入 / 输出 | $3 / $15 | $2 / $10 至 11 月 30 日，之后 $4 / $20 | $4 / $20 | $2 / $10 | 
| AA Intelligence Index | 61 | 未披露 | 59 | 57 | 
| Vals Index v2.2\* | 70.9% | 未披露 | 70.1% | 66.1% | 
| Terminal-bench 4.1\* | 65.2% | 未披露 | 65.8% | 61.5% | 
| SWE-sweep（提供商测试框架）\* | 39.0% | 未披露 | 10.1% | 8.3% | 
| GraphWalks 256K 至 1M\* | 95.2% | 未披露 | 66.8% | 80.1% | 

*\*分数来自 Google 的发布对比表，为自报数据。Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 的 AA 分数与 Artificial Analysis 一致。*

## **要点速览**

- Neon 定位介于 Carbon 和 Hydrogen 之间，定价为每 1M token $3/$15。
- 在 AA Intelligence Index 上得分 61，在 AA Coding Agent Index 上排名第 1。
- 最大领先优势：在 GraphWalks 长上下文召回上达到 95.2%。
- 在 Terminal-bench 4.1 和 FrontierCode 2.0 上落后于 Opus 5.5。
- 闭源且仅提供 API，基准数据由 Google 报告。
